## No 2: Allstate Insurance Group

Allstate Vehicle and Property Insurance Company (37907)

ZIP Code-based territories

12 perils:

- Fire 1
- Fire 2
- Brush Fire
- Water Weather
- Water Non-weather
- Wind
- Hail
- Lightning
- Theft
- Liability
- Hurricane
- Other

::: {.notes}
Their eSurance company in Nevada uses 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4 grid  SERFF ESUR-129867328 Page 920

:::

```{r Read in Allstate Factors & Join to ZCTA File}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code"

# Read in Allstate factor table
allstate_ny <- read_csv("./references_private/allstate_factors.csv",
                        col_names = c("zip",
                                      "fire1", "fire2", "brush_fire", "water_weather",
                                      "water_nonweather", "wind", "hail", "lightning",
                                      "theft", "liability", "hurricane", "other"),
                        skip = 1)

# Join factors to ZIP shapefile
zip_allstate_ny <- zcta %>%
  inner_join(allstate_ny, by = c("ZCTA5CE20" = "zip"))
```
